The [public website repository](https://github.com/afsc-assessments/Council_related_site/tree/main/resources/ABC_TAC) includes the input snapshots under `data/source/`. Download that `ABC_TAC` directory with its `data/`, `scripts/`, `R/`, and `doc/` layout intact. Run the parsers from the archived inputs, followed by the R scripts. Each parser checks the source-file checksums before rebuilding. The Python parsers' `--refresh` option retrieves new catch-report versions; the specification builder retrieves its pinned public Git revision. A later source revision requires a reviewed data update.

The data update verified 552 AKFIN table rows and 1,808 NOAA area/account rows. AKFIN species sums agree with its reported totals within two metric tons, and the two regions sum to the Alaska total within one metric ton. The harvest-specification checks reproduce 225 available measure sums from the source report and preserve 15 all-missing sums as missing.
